biological_interpretation: The active DHX9 response is a nuclear RNP/splicing and pore-basket state, not a collapse of every nuclear-transport target or cytoplasmic RNAi/editing partner. / A putative TPR/nuclear-basket lesion yields a strong cell-selective RNA export/RNA-processing stress state in midbrain and thalamic neurons, but the absence of Tpr mRNA depletion means the hit should be treated as downstream-signature grounded rather than direct transcript-engagement grounded.
caveats: Target-transcript depletion was not FDR-detectable, and several low-count classes had limited power.
Target editing and protein loss were not measured, so low-response subclasses could include weaker guide engagement.
Ranbp2 and Nup93 guides may have different editing efficiencies; Nup93 lacks a significant self-transcript decrease.
Correlations were restricted to Tnpo3-significant genes and do not prove direct physical ordering among TPR, spliceosome factors, and TNPO3.
The cosine similarities are modest and computed from summary signatures, not from replicated perturbation-level covariance.
Score-vector correlations were modest and do not prove direct biochemical interaction.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Dhx9 elicited a cell-selective RNA-processing state involving Trappc11, Glo1, Iqgap1, Prpf38a, Riok3, Atat1, Dusp11, Son, Ccdc93, and Snhg11; Tpr, Tnpo3, and Ranbp2 placed this response near nuclear-pore basket, SR/splicing, and nuclear-transport perturbations but away from Nup93, Kpna3, Xpo7, Dicer/Ago, and Adar arms. / Tpr ranked fourth in the footprint sweep with 5087 significant cell-gene pairs across 10 contexts, 50% in 155 MB Glut, and no on-target FDR support. The Tpr report found 5216 FDR<0.05 gene hits across 21 measured subclasses, dominated by 2578 in 155 MB Glut and 1768 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; the recurrent module included Ranbp6, Xpo1, Pigm, Med13, Tob1, and Zfp281 up and Rnpc3, Ogt, Ddx17, Amy1, Leng8, and Snhg11 down. Eleven subclasses, including 052 Pvalb Gaba with 86 perturbed cells, had zero FDR genes. Parquet-verified leading rows: Dhx9->Trappc11 in 155 MB Glut log2FC 1.79, FDR 7.78e-30; Dhx9->Iqgap1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC 1.51, FDR 9.38e-25; Dhx9->Trappc11 in 191 MB P MY GABA log2FC 2.04, FDR 1.02e-24; Dhx9->Zfp811 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC 2.02, FDR 8.02e-20; Tpr->Snhg11 in 155 MB Glut log2FC -1.01, FDR 1.05e-19; Tpr->Tob1 in 155 MB Glut log2FC 1.67, FDR 1.55e-19.

finding_summaries.direction: response concentrated in selected neuronal classes
finding_summaries.summary: Dhx9 perturbation produced a sharply restricted neuronal response rather than a pan-neuronal expression program.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: DHX9 is broadly expressed in brain resources, so the concentration of 207/243 FDR-significant rows in three thalamic, midbrain, and hindbrain classes suggests that the downstream state change is controlled by cellular context rather than baseline detectability alone.

finding_summaries.direction: strong in 155 MB Glut and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; absent or buffered in 11 of 21 measured subclasses
finding_summaries.summary: Tpr perturbation produced a highly subclass-restricted response, dominated by 155 MB Glut and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut while many subclasses had no FDR-significant genes.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: A ubiquitous nuclear-basket mRNA-export factor did not yield a uniform neuronal phenotype; vulnerable midbrain and thalamic subclasses were much more transcriptionally responsive than many cortical and GABA subclasses.

finding_summaries.direction: Ranbp2 weakly similar; Nup93 divergent and silent
finding_summaries.summary: Tpr partially converged with the cytoplasmic-filament nucleoporin Ranbp2 but sharply diverged from Nup93, whose perturbation was transcriptionally silent across all tested subclasses.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The nuclear-pore phenotype is subcomplex-specific; the Tpr response cannot be inferred from a generic NPC perturbation and is not phenocopied by Nup93 in this dataset.

finding_summaries.summary: Tnpo3 signatures aligned with Srsf1, Tpr, Prpf6, and Ddx23 perturbations but were absent or weaker for Kpna3, Xpo7, and Xpo1.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: This contrast narrows the interpretation to SR/splicing and nuclear-pore-basket RNA trafficking instead of a generic importin/exportin perturbation state.

finding_summaries.direction: weakly similar for Tpr/Tnpo3 and near-neutral for Nup93/Xpo1/Xpo7/Kpna3
finding_summaries.summary: Ranbp2 signatures weakly converged with Tpr and Tnpo3 but not with every assayed nuclear-transport perturbation.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The result argues against treating all nuclear pore or transport genes as interchangeable; the closest dataset neighbors point to a limited TPR/import-export axis plus proteasome and splicing perturbations.

finding_summaries.summary: Tpr signatures repeatedly placed spliceosome, RNA-export, proteasome, and UFMylation perturbations among the closest positive neighbors.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The neighbor structure links Tpr loss to a broader post-transcriptional and proteostasis stress axis beyond one nuclear-basket gene.

resolved_evidence.description: Most Dhx9-associated transcriptomic signal was concentrated in a few neuronal classes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 371,818 Dhx9 rows covering 22 cell classes; 243 rows were FDR<0.05, representing 148 genes in 9 cell classes. FDR<0.05 row counts: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut 116, 155 MB Glut 55, 191 MB P MY GABA 36, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA 11, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut 9, 052 Pvalb Gaba 9, 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut 4, 145 MH-LH TH Glut 2, 054 CNU-MGE GABA 1.

resolved_evidence.description: Second-largest Dhx9 signature, in midbrain glutamatergic neurons.
Third-largest Dhx9 signature, in a GABAergic midbrain-pons-medulla class.
Moderate or very small Dhx9 signatures retained the recurrent core but had few FDR-significant genes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: FDR<0.05 row counts and examples: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 57 cells, 11 genes including Trappc11 FDR 9.79e-14 and Snhg11/Leng8 FDR 0.0156; 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 50 cells, 9 genes including Riok3 FDR 2.84e-6 and Zcchc7 FDR 0.00587; 052 Pvalb Gaba, 80 cells, 9 genes; 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 91 cells, 4 genes; 145 MH-LH TH Glut, 47 cells, 2 genes; 054 CNU-MGE GABA, 45 cells, only Riok3 at FDR 0.0164.

resolved_evidence.description: Several classes had matched-cell counts comparable to responsive classes but lacked FDR-significant downstream expression changes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Thirteen of 22 Dhx9-tested cell classes had 0 FDR<0.05 genes: 001 L5-6 IT Glut n=27, 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut n=59, 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut n=40, 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut n=53, 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut n=51, 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut n=35, 022 L5 ET CTX Glut n=56, 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut n=29, 046 CTX-CGE GABA n=47, 053 Sst Gaba n=26, 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA n=57, 217 P MY Pineal Glut n=20, and 308 CB GABA n=51.

resolved_evidence.description: The largest Tpr differential-expression response occurred in 155 MB Glut.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 96 perturbed cells versus 20,353 controls; 2,578 genes at pvals_adj < 0.05; top scores included Tob1 score 9.98 logFC 1.67 FDR 1.55e-19, Chd9 score 9.82 logFC 1.23 FDR 5.23e-19, Ranbp6 score 9.58 logFC 1.55 FDR 3.27e-18, and Snhg11 score -10.09 logFC -1.01 FDR 1.05e-19.

resolved_evidence.description: A second very large Tpr response was observed in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 114 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; 1,768 genes at pvals_adj < 0.05; Xpo1 score 8.61 logFC 0.96 FDR 3.20e-14, Ranbp6 score 7.36 logFC 1.06 FDR 1.54e-10, Leng8 score -9.41 logFC -0.76 FDR 8.44e-17, and Ogt score -8.30 logFC -0.63 FDR 3.10e-13.

resolved_evidence.description: Tpr also produced smaller significant signatures in a set of cortical, thalamic, midbrain, hindbrain, and GABA subclasses.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Adjusted-p < 0.05 gene counts outside the top two subclasses were 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut 301, 191 MB P MY GABA 246, 145 MH-LH TH Glut 174, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA 91, 308 CB GABA 42, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut 10, 022 L5 ET CTX Glut 4, and 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut 2.

resolved_evidence.description: Many subclasses had no significant downstream Tpr response despite usable cell counts.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 11 of 21 measured Tpr subclasses had zero genes with pvals_adj < 0.05; examples with substantial matched cells were 052 Pvalb Gaba with 86 perturbed cells and min FDR 0.189, 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut with 65 cells and min FDR 0.271, and 046 CTX-CGE GABA with 50 cells and min FDR 0.614.

resolved_evidence.description: Ranbp2 partially resembled Tpr by correlation but produced a weaker and differently distributed DE phenotype.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Ranbp2 was a top-10 positive Tpr score-correlation neighbor in 12 of 21 Tpr subclasses. Correlation was 0.360 in 155 MB Glut, 0.229 in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, and 0.218 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut. Ranbp2 perturbation yielded 35 FDR<0.05 genes in 155 MB Glut, 2 in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, and 0 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.

resolved_evidence.description: The Nup93 comparator lacked a significant downstream signature and did not track the Tpr signature.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Nup93 perturbation produced 0 adjusted-p < 0.05 genes in all 22 Nup93 result subclasses, including 125 Nup93 cells in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 130 in 155 MB Glut. The maximum Tpr-versus-Nup93 score correlation in a shared subclass was 0.092; correlations in 151 and 155 were 0.071 and 0.033.

resolved_evidence.description: Restricted-signature correlations identified Srsf1, Tpr, Prpf6, and Ddx23 as reproducible positive neighbors of Tnpo3 in active cell classes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Pearson correlations against Tnpo3 FDR genes in 066/151/155/191 were: Srsf1 r=0.692/0.683/0.678/0.687; Tpr r=0.478/0.755/0.751/0.677; Prpf6 r=0.633/0.682/0.631/0.656; Ddx23 r=0.606/0.502/0.579/0.553. Tnpo3 FDR-gene set sizes were 40, 618, 215, and 288 respectively.

resolved_evidence.description: Comparator import/export factors were absent or only partially aligned with the Tnpo3 state, arguing against a uniform nuclear-transport response.
resolved_evidence.statistics: In the four strongest Tnpo3-responsive classes, Kpna3 had 0 FDR<0.05 genes in each and restricted correlations from -0.065 to 0.031; Xpo7 had 0 FDR<0.05 genes in each and correlations 0.083 to 0.207; Xpo1 had 9, 514, 91, and 32 FDR<0.05 genes with correlations 0.285, 0.566, 0.433, and 0.306 in 066, 151, 155, and 191 respectively.

resolved_evidence.description: The major Tnpo3-responsive classes were also strongly affected by direct Srsf1 perturbation.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Srsf1 perturbation produced FDR<0.05 counts of 733 in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 2765 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 1456 in 155 MB Glut, and 1118 in 191 MB P MY GABA.

resolved_evidence.description: Restricted-signature comparison placed the nuclear-pore basket protein Tpr and import factor Tnpo3 among the closest Ranbp2-positive neighbors, whereas several assayed nuclear-transport neighbors were near neutral.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Genome-wide score cosine correlations to Ranbp2 over the 20 overlapping cell types ranked Tpr 6th overall including Ranbp2 itself, cosine=0.151, and Tnpo3 8th, cosine=0.130, among targets with at least 15 overlapping cell types. Xpo1 ranked 52nd, cosine=0.0526; Nup93 127th, cosine=0.0335; Xpo7 170th, cosine=0.0300; Kpna3 1391st, cosine=-0.00133. Proteasome/splicing targets Psmb4 and Prpf6 ranked 2nd and 4th with cosines 0.184 and 0.169.

resolved_evidence.description: Full-signature comparison linked Tpr to a recurrent neighborhood of RNA-processing, mRNA-export, proteasome, and UFMylation perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Among top-10 positive score-correlation neighbors of Tpr across 21 subclasses, Prpf6 appeared 14 times; Psmb4, Ranbp2, Psmc1, and Psmc5 each appeared 12 times; Cdc40 appeared 8 times; Ddx39b appeared 7 times; Ufc1, Ogt, Pomp, Thoc1, and Tnpo3 each appeared 6 times. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Tnpo3, Uba5, and Ufc1 had correlations 0.422, 0.419, and 0.414; in 155 MB Glut, Prpf6, Psmb4, Psmc5, and Psmc1 had correlations 0.394, 0.388, 0.383, and 0.382.

title: Dhx9 and nuclear-pore transport perturbations expose a nuclear RNP/splicing state rather than Dicer/Ago or generic karyopherin loss
